inputs.prompt:
Edit image 1. Keep the woman in image 1 exactly as she is: the same body proportions and curves, the same standing pose and hand position, the same face, the same outfit, the same mid-thigh crop, the same ink-brush painting medium, and the same flat solid magenta #FF00FF background everywhere outside the figure.
Change ONLY her hair and accessory.
Her hair is now completely shaved, with a smooth bare scalp and a clean smooth forehead and hairline. The hair is painted in the same black ink-wash and dry-brush style as image 1, with a clean outline against the flat magenta background.
She now wears small plain silver ear studs. The ornaments are painted in the same ink-wash style as image 1 with crisp clean edges.
Only one character. No text, no logo, no watermark.
inputs.negative_prompt: copied reference character, copied costume or pose, multiple characters, full-length figure, knees, shins, feet, scenery, floor, ground, shadows, gradient background, ink splashes outside the character, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, signature, frame, UI
